knowledge:
- key_parameters: method=Specifies the test statistic variant ("fc" for fold change equivalent, "t" for t-test, "z" for Z-test, "pearson" or "spearman" for correlation) ;; paired=Logical indicating if the samples are paired ;; B=Number of permutations for estimating the null distribution ;; yperm=Optional user-specified permutation matrix ;; filtering=Logical to enable permutation filtering in twilight.pval ;; lambda=Regularization parameter for the successive exclusion procedure ;; boot.ci=Width of the bootstrap confidence interval
- alternatives: Classical t-test (method="t") and Z-test (method="z") with a fudge factor are alternatives to the fold change equivalent score (method="fc"). The package also suggests using vsn for variance-stabilizing normalization prior to analysis.
- when_to_use: Appropriate for two-sample transcriptomics or microarray experiments on an additive scale to identify differentially expressed genes, estimate local false discovery rates, or correlate gene expression with continuous clinical parameters.
- pitfalls: Input data must be on an additive scale (e.g., log or arsinh) as the package does not perform this transformation automatically. If using a custom permutation matrix yperm, the first row must contain the original labels to ensure correct p-value calculation. Permutation filtering is computationally intensive.

workflows.name: differential_expression_analysis
workflows.intent: Test for differential gene expression between two conditions and estimate local false discovery rates.
input: expression_matrix.csv (normalized gene expression matrix on additive scale)
workflows.stages: 1. Compute permutation-based p-values and q-values using twilight.pval ;; 2. Estimate local false discovery rates and bootstrap confidence intervals using twilight ;; 3. Plot expected vs observed scores, q-values, local FDR curve, volcano plot, and effect size distribution
workflows.code:
library(twilight)
pval <- twilight.pval(golubNorm, id, B=100)
plot(expval,which="scores",grayscale=F,legend=F)
plot(expval,which="qvalues")
plot(exfdr,which="fdr",grayscale=F,legend=T)
plot(exfdr,which="volcano")
plot(exfdr,which="effectsize",legend=T)
tab <- plot(exfdr,which="table")

workflows.name: correlation_analysis
workflows.intent: Identify genes whose expression levels correlate with a continuous clinical parameter.
workflows.stages: 1. Extract the continuous clinical parameter vector ;; 2. Compute correlation-based p-values and q-values using twilight.pval with Spearman or Pearson method ;; 3. Plot the correlation scores

workflows.name: permutation_filtering
workflows.intent: Filter for a set of permutations whose p-value distributions fit a uniform distribution to improve significance analysis.
workflows.stages: 1. Run permutation filtering using twilight.filtering to obtain a matrix of filtered permutations ;; 2. Remove the original labeling from the first row of the filtered permutation matrix ;; 3. Compute p-values using twilight.pval with the filtered permutation matrix passed to yperm ;; 4. Plot a histogram of the resulting p-values to verify uniformity
